caption.text:
Menteri Pekerjaan Umum Dody Hanggodo membantah mutasi pejabat di kementeriannya terkait bocornya dokumen rencana perjalanan dirinya dan keluarga ke Amerika Serikat.

Dody menegaskan, mutasi tersebut merupakan hal biasa dan tidak ada hubungannya dengan kebocoran dokumen.

#Okezone #MenteriPU #Mutasi
caption.text_translation:
Minister of Public Works Dody Hanggodo has denied the mutation of officials in his ministry over the leak of his and his family’s travel plans to the United States.

Dody confirms the mutations were common and had nothing to do with document leak.

 #Okezone #MenteriPU #Mutasi
